headline: Record profit drives another full-year outlook raise
summary_short: Net income rose 27% year over year to $298.6 million as diluted EPS climbed 30% to $5.95, with both Global Lifestyle and Global Housing posting double-digit Adjusted EBITDA growth; Assurant raised its full-year 2026 outlook to mid-single-digit Adjusted EBITDA and EPS growth.
summary_long: Total revenue rose 9% y/y to $3.45 billion as net income grew 27% to $298.6 million and diluted EPS rose 30% to $5.95. Global Lifestyle Adjusted EBITDA grew 21% on Connected Living (including $10 million of favorable non-run-rate items) and Global Automotive growth; Global Housing Adjusted EBITDA grew 28% (18% ex-catastrophes) on favorable non-catastrophe loss experience and lower catastrophe reinsurance costs, partly offset by lower favorable prior-period reserve development. Corporate and Other's EBITDA loss widened on higher employee costs and Home Warranty investment. Stockholders' equity rose to $6.10 billion and holding-company liquidity was $911 million. Assurant raised 2026 guidance to mid-single-digit Adjusted EBITDA and EPS growth (ex-catastrophes), with Global Lifestyle now expected to grow low double digits.
